title: Energy-Aware HDMPC with Digital-Twin xIL for Jiaodong Water Transfer

history.key_changes: Initialized P2D draft with CHS-consistent formulation, energy-aware HDMPC objective skeleton, digital-twin xIL chain, and initial deployment governance gates for Jiaodong transfer.
Added executable ODD envelope and violation policy, energy KPI package for campaign assessment, and SCADA-linked operator checklist with role-bound fallback accountability.
Added bounded contribution statement, explicit transferability prerequisites/non-transfer conditions, and responsible autonomy communication boundary aligned with P2A WSAL semantics.
Formalized deployment gate predicates (Eq.4), added freshness-constrained effective gates (Eq.5), and separated authorization implication from dynamics with Eq.(6).
Added rollback SLO constraint (Eq.7), alarm triage-to-authority matrix, and multi-shift handover continuity artifacts linked to fallback gate and closure readiness.
